acts: Unicode Standard Annex #14, Unicode Line Breaking Algorithm, revision 57
Unicode Standard Annex #29, Unicode Text Segmentation, revision 49

en.title: UAX #14 rev. 57, Section 5.1 class XX: unassigned code points outside CJK blocks are not all XX
en.summary: The class XX description includes all unassigned code points that are not within a CJK block. The PR description in the same section puts unassigned code points of the Currency Symbols block in PR, and LineBreak.txt 18.0.0 gives most unassigned code points in U+1F000..U+1FAFF and U+1FC00..U+1FFFD the default ID.
en.impact: U+0061, unassigned U+1FAFF, U+0062: as XX (AL after LB1) no break on either side; as ID (data) a break on both sides, which is what LineBreakTest.txt and the published implementations give.
en.correction: Say that unassigned code points are XX unless the data file gives them another default, such as PR or ID.

quotes.text: The XX line break class consists of all characters with General_Category Co as well as those unassigned code points that are not within a CJK block.
This class also contains all unassigned code points in the Currency Symbols block

responsible.role: publishes the annex and the Unicode Character Database

ai_role.en: AI agents read the annexes and the data files and compared them; the examples were run through published implementations. An AI coordinator checked each place against the full annex and the trackers, and two further AI models checked the report before filing.
